card.name: Final piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a newer brand-name drug split into several parts, such as MYCAPSSA, KISUNLA, TALVEY or AUVELITY. It fires in prescribing-information text, right before the name is complete.

modes.label: Ending of a brand name
modes.description: Final letters of an unusual brand name used as the subject of a dosing or warning sentence.
modes.example: Administer TALVE<<Y>> subcutaneously according to the step-up

modes.label: Brand name in a heading or warning
modes.description: Final piece of a brand name after a section heading or in a risk statement.
modes.example: 5.1 Cholelithiasis and Complications of Cholelithiasis MYCAPSS<<A>>

card.writes: It likely helps the model decide the brand name is complete and that ordinary text such as punctuation or a verb comes next.
card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of a newer, oddly spelled brand-name drug when the label mentions it.
